preToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat); t=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | grep -o '"toolName":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"toolName":"//; s/"$//'); mkdir -p logs; ms=$(date +%s%3N); now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); printf '%s\t%s' "$ms" "$t" > logs/.strategist-tool-start; printf '{"event":"toolStart","at":"%s","epoch_ms":%s,"tool":"%s"}\n' "$now" "$ms" "$t" >> logs/strategist-tools.jsonl; exit 0
preToolUse.powershell: try { $in=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $o=$in | ConvertFrom-Json; $t=[string]$o.toolName; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; $ms=[int64]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()); $now=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); Set-Content -Path logs/.strategist-tool-start -Value ("$ms`t$t"); Add-Content -Path logs/strategist-tools.jsonl -Value ('{"event":"toolStart","at":"'+$now+'","epoch_ms":'+$ms+',"tool":"'+$t+'"}') } catch {}; exit 0

postToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat); t=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | grep -o '"toolName":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"toolName":"//; s/"$//'); end=$(date +%s%3N); now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); start=$(cut -f1 logs/.strategist-tool-start 2>/dev/null || echo ""); dur=null; if [ -n "$start" ]; then dur=$((end-start)); fi; printf '{"event":"toolEnd","at":"%s","epoch_ms":%s,"tool":"%s","duration_ms":%s,"result":"success"}\n' "$now" "$end" "$t" "$dur" >> logs/strategist-tools.jsonl; exit 0
postToolUse.powershell: try { $in=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $o=$in | ConvertFrom-Json; $t=[string]$o.toolName } catch { $t='' }; $end=[int64]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()); $now=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); $line=(Get-Content -Path logs/.strategist-tool-start -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1); if ($line) { $dur=$end-[int64](($line -split "`t")[0]) } else { $dur='null' }; Add-Content -Path logs/strategist-tools.jsonl -Value ('{"event":"toolEnd","at":"'+$now+'","epoch_ms":'+$end+',"tool":"'+$t+'","duration_ms":'+$dur+',"result":"success"}'); exit 0

postToolUseFailure.bash: INPUT=$(cat); t=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | grep -o '"toolName":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"toolName":"//; s/"$//'); end=$(date +%s%3N); now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); start=$(cut -f1 logs/.strategist-tool-start 2>/dev/null || echo ""); dur=null; if [ -n "$start" ]; then dur=$((end-start)); fi; printf '{"event":"toolEnd","at":"%s","epoch_ms":%s,"tool":"%s","duration_ms":%s,"result":"failure"}\n' "$now" "$end" "$t" "$dur" >> logs/strategist-tools.jsonl; exit 0
postToolUseFailure.powershell: try { $in=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $o=$in | ConvertFrom-Json; $t=[string]$o.toolName } catch { $t='' }; $end=[int64]([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()); $now=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); $line=(Get-Content -Path logs/.strategist-tool-start -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1); if ($line) { $dur=$end-[int64](($line -split "`t")[0]) } else { $dur='null' }; Add-Content -Path logs/strategist-tools.jsonl -Value ('{"event":"toolEnd","at":"'+$now+'","epoch_ms":'+$end+',"tool":"'+$t+'","duration_ms":'+$dur+',"result":"failure"}'); exit 0
